notes.subject: כתמר מקשה
notes.rationale: 'dɛgɛn-kurun min bɛ nɔ daali' (palm-trunk of repoussé work) vs JPS 'pillar in a garden of cucumbers' vs BSB 'scarecrows in a cucumber patch' — the image of a stiff, carried object is kept.

notes.subject: נשוא ינשוא
notes.rationale: Infinitive and finite verb of the same root side by side — 'they are carried, surely carried' — emphasis flattened to one clause.

notes.subject: אותם
notes.rationale: אותם here is the pronoun 'them' (it is not in THEM), not the direct-object marker; rendered 'u kɔnɔ' without brackets.

notes.subject: aw k'u siran
notes.rationale: Negative imperative addressed to Israel (the hearers of Jeremiah's speech), not to the idols.

translation: Olu bɛ ki i n'a fɔ dɛgɛn-kurun min bɛ nɔ daali, wa u tɛ kuma: bɛɛ bɛ u ta, sabu u tɛ se ka taa. Aw k'u siran, sabu u tɛ se ka jugu kɛ, wa ka di kɛ fana, o si tɛ ⟨את⟩ u kɔnɔ.

tokens.gloss: min bɛ nɔ daali ka dilan
